description: PDF generation and reMarkable upload were handled directly by Master instead of routing to Knox. Knox owns both the PDF-to-remarkable pipeline and the remarkable-upload skill. Master should have spawned Knox with the markdown source and let Knox handle naming, PDF creation, folder routing, and upload.
correction: Route all reMarkable upload requests to Knox immediately. Knox's remarkable-upload skill handles naming conventions, folder routing, Finder bridge pattern, and upload verification.
systemic_fix: Knox trigger keywords in routing.md already include 'upload to remarkable' and 'send to tablet'. Master must read routing.md before acting on any file delivery request. No exceptions for 'quick' uploads.
